_note: Cuts a tagged release. Policy: docs/adr/0001-release-at-milestone-end.md. Not selected by /pipeline-next from a ROADMAP row type — copy this template to .pipeline-state/release-vX.Y.Z.json by hand, set target_version, then /pipeline-run. The two-commit shape (implementation commit must not touch CHANGELOG) is deliberately WAIVED here: the version bump and the CHANGELOG promotion are one atomic fact, and splitting them produces a commit that claims a version it does not set. Stage 6 records the waiver.

checklist.action: run scripts/release-ready.sh <target_version> and paste its full output into the state file
the gate must exit 0 (READY). A ✗ row is a stop, not a judgement call — resolve it or, if the row is wrong, fix the gate and say so in the PR
confirm CI is green on the main commit being released: gh run list --branch main --limit 3
output GATE_READY or GATE_BLOCKED <reasons>
git fetch origin && checkout release/v<target_version> from origin/main
verify JDK + Gradle wrapper (./gradlew --version)
output ENV_OK or ENV_FAILED
set versionName in app/build.gradle.kts to the target version WITHOUT the leading v
increment versionCode by 1 — Obtainium and the package manager order installs by this, not by versionName

run the release workflow's OWN parser against the edited file and confirm it yields the target: sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*versionName = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' app/build.gradle.kts. A reformat that breaks this regex fails the tag push, not the build
output VERSION_BUMPED <old> -> <new>, versionCode <old> -> <new>
rename ## [Unreleased] to ## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD and insert a fresh empty ## [Unreleased] above it

list every PR merged since the previous tag (gh pr list --state merged --json number,title,mergedAt) and confirm each user-visible one is represented in the new section — a PR with no CHANGELOG line is either missing or deliberately internal; say which
DERIVE every number in the release notes from a command, never transcribe one from memory or from an earlier PR body (v0.5.0 retro: a stale :core count reached CHANGELOG this way)
quantifier audit the new section: grep -nE 'always|never|every|all|cannot|incapable|has emitted|since' and verify each surviving claim against code or command output, or soften it
strike the release row in the ROADMAP priority matrix and add the ✅ shipped note to the milestone section
move the milestone into ROADMAP's ## Completed section with its PR range and a retro pointer
output DOCS_UPDATED with the section heading and PR count covered
./gradlew :core:test :app:testDebugUnitTest --rerun-tasks — the flag is mandatory: an UP-TO-DATE run replays a previous result and verifies nothing
read the counts out of build/test-results/**/*.xml rather than trusting the console summary; record tests/failures/errors per module
./gradlew :app:lintDebug — clean, or every warning explained
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
state plainly that the RELEASE apk was NOT built locally — signing keys live only in CI, so the signed artifact is first produced at stage 11 and is unverified until then
output BUILD_VERIFIED <counts> or BUILD_FAILED
branch-verify reflex: HEAD matches this state file's branch_name

single commit 'chore: release vX.Y.Z' carrying the bump + CHANGELOG + ROADMAP together. The two-commit shape is waived here — record the waiver in the PR body so a reviewer does not read it as a Gate 1 violation
verify the commit contains ONLY app/build.gradle.kts, CHANGELOG.md and ROADMAP.md — any other file means unrelated work is riding the release
git push -u origin && gh pr create with the release notes as the body
output PR_CREATED

7.name: Code Review
7.subagent_prompt: Review this release PR with git diff origin/main...HEAD (three-dot). Check, in order: (1) versionName and versionCode both bumped, and the workflow's sed parser still extracts versionName from the edited line; (2) the CHANGELOG section covers every merged PR since the previous tag — enumerate them yourself with gh rather than trusting the PR body; (3) every number in the notes is reproducible from a command you run, not asserted; (4) every absolute quantifier (always/never/every/all/cannot) in the new section is true against the code; (5) nothing but the three release files is in the diff. Post the review with gh pr review --comment. Restore the working tree and HEAD to the PR branch before exiting.

checklist.action: spawn the review subagent with the prompt above
confirm the review landed on the PR (gh pr view --json reviews)
output APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES <findings>
address every finding, or record why it is declined
output FINDINGS_RESOLVED
gh pr checks — CI green
user has approved the merge (project rule: no PR merges without it)
gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
output PR_MERGED <sha>
git checkout main && git pull --ff-only — the tag goes on the squash-merge commit on main, never on the deleted branch head
confirm HEAD's app/build.gradle.kts yields the target version through the workflow's own sed, and that HEAD is the merge commit from stage 9
git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z
output TAG_PUSHED <tag> <sha>
watch the release workflow to completion: gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow=release.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')
confirm the GitHub release exists AND carries app-release.apk with a plausible size: gh release view vX.Y.Z --json assets. A release with no asset is a failed release even when the workflow is green
if the workflow failed, DELETE the tag (git push origin :refs/tags/vX.Y.Z) before retrying — a tag that exists without a release is the state the gate reads as 'already shipped'
hand off the hardware half: the owed smoke rows (GitHub #33) are runnable only once this APK is installed — say so explicitly rather than closing the milestone as fully verified
output RELEASE_PUBLISHED <url> or RELEASE_FAILED
rate quality 1-5
what went well + lessons learned; IDEA: lines for improvements
did the gate's verdict match reality? A gate that said READY when it should not have is a finding about the gate, not about the release
post retrospective to the PR: gh pr comment
append to .pipeline-log.md
output RETRO_COMPLETE
